description: One locale only, so no policy consultation is possible and the resolver-plus-handler pair is isolated. The resolver always throws a distinctively worded sentinel. Alongside the phonetic key sit a key that is simply absent from the catalog and an alternatives-only key whose sole predicate is false, so the two CAUSELESS failure reasons can be contrasted with the resolver's caused one under the same throwing handler.

Guest.Welcome.commentary: Alternatives-only with no default translation: an unmatched predicate yields NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE and no throwable.
